name: stromkirk_noble_humans_cannot_block_it
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'This creature can't be blocked by Humans. Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.' The Noble attacks. Seat 1's Human Soldier has no legal block and is never asked; seat 1's Bear, not a Human, may block it, and does: the Noble (1/1) dies, deals no combat damage to a player, and gets no counter.
